text: Look, everyone! I brought my favorite red ball!
translation: 大家快看！我带来了我最喜欢的红色小球！
emotion: Excited and proud, holding the red ball up with both forepaws

text: Wow! It’s so pretty! Can I play with it, please?
translation: 哇！它真漂亮！我可以玩一下吗？
emotion: Delighted and polite, leaning in toward the ball

text: Of course, Jacky! Here you go!
translation: 当然可以，奇奇！给你！
emotion: Warm and generous, holding the ball out to the chick

text: Thank you, Soda! You’re so kind!
translation: 谢谢你，小苏打！你真友善！
emotion: Happy and grateful, small hop in place

text: Ooh! I want to play, too! Can I have a turn?
translation: 哦！我也想玩！可以轮到我玩一下吗？
emotion: Eager and a bit shy, one front paw lifted toward the ball

text: Sure, Mimi! Let’s take turns!
translation: 当然可以，小咪！我们轮流玩吧！
emotion: Cheerful and fair-minded, wing gesturing between the two

text: Yay! Thank you! I’ll be careful!
translation: 耶！谢谢你们！我会小心玩的！
emotion: Excited and careful, eyes bright

text: That’s the way! We can all have fun together!
translation: 这就对啦！我们大家可以一起开心地玩！
emotion: Pleased and encouraging, nodding at the group

text: Wheee! I love this ball! It’s so much fun!
translation: 喔耶！我好喜欢这个球！太好玩啦！
emotion: Joyful while rolling the ball, body low and playful

text: Mimi, can I have the ball when you’re done?
translation: 小咪，你玩好之后，可以把球给我吗？
emotion: Polite and patient, head tilted toward the kitten

text: Sure! Just one more roll!
translation: 当然可以！我再滚一次就好！
emotion: Easy-going and playful, one paw on the ball

text: Okay! I can wait!
translation: 好呀！我可以等一等！
emotion: Calm and patient, sitting down to wait

text: All done! Here you go, Jacky!
translation: 玩好啦！给你，奇奇！
emotion: Bright and helpful, pushing the ball over

text: Thanks! You’re a great friend!
translation: 谢谢！你真是个好朋友！
emotion: Warm and thankful, wings up

text: See? Taking turns makes everyone happy!
translation: 你们看！轮流玩能让每个人都开心！
emotion: Satisfied and teacherly, looking at both friends

text: You’re right! We don’t have to play with everything at the same time!
translation: 你说得对！我们不一定要同时玩同一个玩具！
emotion: Earnest, thinking it through as she speaks

text: And we can wait patiently for our turn!
translation: 而且我们可以耐心地等待轮到自己！
emotion: Patient and proud of himself

text: That’s right! Good friends share and care!
translation: 没错！好朋友懂得分享，也会关心彼此！
emotion: Content and warm, nodding

text: Hey, friends! I brought some yummy snacks!
translation: 嘿，朋友们！我带了一些好吃的小点心！
emotion: Cheerful and generous, opening the snack box

text: Yum! They look delicious!
translation: 哇！看起来好好吃呀！
emotion: Curious and hungry, sniffing toward the snacks

text: That’s so nice of you, Jacky! Can we share them?
translation: 奇奇，你真好！我们可以一起分享吗？
emotion: Polite and happy, looking at the chick

text: Of course! I brought enough for everyone!
translation: 当然可以！我带的点心够大家一起吃！
emotion: Generous and relaxed, setting the box down

text: Thank you! Sharing makes snack time even better!
translation: 谢谢你！一起分享，吃点心就更开心啦！
emotion: Grateful and bright, tail tip flicking

text: Here, Mimi. You can have this one!
translation: 来，小咪。这个给你！
emotion: Kind, offering a snack with one paw

text: Thanks, Soda! And this one is for you!
translation: 谢谢你，小苏打！这个给你！
emotion: Warm, pushing a snack back toward the puppy

text: And let’s save a little for later, too!
translation: 我们也留一点，等会儿再吃吧！
emotion: Thoughtful, saving a piece and covering it lightly

text: Great idea! We don’t need to take everything for ourselves.
translation: 好主意！我们不能把所有东西都留给自己。
emotion: Agreeing and happy, nodding

text: When we share, everyone gets a little happiness!
translation: 当我们分享时，每个人都能收获一点快乐！
emotion: Soft and content, looking around the group

text: That’s why sharing is caring!
translation: 所以说，分享就是关爱！
emotion: Pleased, wings out in a small flourish

text: Oh, no! My blocks fell down!
translation: 哦，不！我的积木倒了！
emotion: Alarmed and upset, looking down at the fallen blocks

text: Don’t worry, Jacky! I’ll help you pick them up.
translation: 别担心，奇奇！我来帮你捡起来。
emotion: Reassuring and quick to help, already stepping closer

text: Me, too! Let’s clean up together!
translation: 我也来！我们一起收拾吧！
emotion: Eager to help, trotting toward the blocks

text: Really? Thank you, friends!
translation: 真的吗？谢谢你们，我的朋友们！
emotion: Touched and relieved, eyes wide

text: No problem! Friends help each other!
translation: 没关系！好朋友之间要互相帮助！
emotion: Warm and matter-of-fact, holding a block

text: Here’s the last block!
translation: 最后一块积木在这里！
emotion: Proud, holding up the last block

text: We did it! Everything is back in place!
translation: 我们做到了！所有东西都放回原位啦！
emotion: Happy and satisfied, looking at the tidy tower

text: Yay! Teamwork makes things easier!
translation: 耶！大家一起合作，事情就容易多啦！
emotion: Cheerful, little bounce

text: I’m so happy to have friends like you!
translation: 有你们这样的朋友，我真开心！
emotion: Warm and sincere, looking at both friends

text: Me, too! We share, we help, and we have fun!
translation: 我也是！我们一起分享、互相帮助，还能一起玩得开心！
emotion: Happy and a bit proud, wings up

text: Best friends forever!
translation: 永远都是最好的朋友！
emotion: Bright and affectionate, tail up
